abstract: The chick chorioallantoic membrane (CAM) was used as an assay system to examine the invasive potential of human choriocarcinoma cell lines. When 5 X 10(6) cells were inoculated into the CAM at the 10th day of postfertilization, three of eight cell lines formed extensively invasive tumors within the CAM. A tendency to correlation between the tumorigenic potential of cell lines in hamster cheek pouches and their invasive potential in the CAM was noted. In addition, the invasive capacity of cell lines correlated well with the amount of collagenase but did not correlate with the amount of plasminogen activator or cathepsin B secreted by them. It is concluded that a heterogeneity of invasive potential in the CAM exists among human choriocarcinoma cell lines and the role of the collagenase secreted by them is suggested.
abstract_ja: ニワトリ漿尿膜(CAM)をアッセイ系として、ヒト絨毛癌細胞株の浸潤能を検討した。受精後10日目のCAMに5×10^6個の細胞を接種したところ、8株中3株でCAM内に広範囲に浸潤する腫瘍が形成された。ハムスター頬袋における腫瘍形成能とCAMにおける浸潤能との間には、相関の傾向がみられた。細胞株の浸潤能はコラゲナーゼ量とよく相関したが、プラスミノーゲンアクチベーターやカテプシンBの分泌量とは相関しなかった。したがって、ヒト絨毛癌細胞株間では浸潤能に不均一性が存在し、それらが分泌するコラゲナーゼの役割が示唆されると結論した。
